en.title: WHY JAPANESE WOMEN GO BACK TO PARENTS AFTER GIVING BIRTH?
en.description:
In Japan, there’s a tradition called *satogaeri* (里帰り), where after giving birth, the wife returns to her parents’ home with the baby and stays there for a while.

It’s not a common practice in Korea, but what’s even more surprising is that the husband usually stays behind, and only the wife goes back home with the baby! (Doesn’t that remind you of something other than a chocolate bar? 🤣)

Originally, we planned to go together as a family to Kuriko’s hometown in Kagoshima and stay there. But as it turned out, Gyeongsik suddenly had work in Japan, so he had to travel back and forth between different cities in Japan and Korea.

And just like that, Kuriko ended up raising the baby on her own at her parents’ home…

After a year and a half, she’s finally enjoying home-cooked meals again, spending precious time with her mom and the baby. And so, Kuriko’s *satogaeri* journey has officially begun :)

But thankfully, he ate well, slept well, and handled everything so bravely haha.
We arrived safely, and our life in Japan has officially begun.

en.title: TRYING TO TAKE A PASSPORT FOR A NEWBORN!😂
en.description:
We’re planning to go to Japan soon, so we made Piyo’s very first passport! We tried taking the passport photo at home, but since he’s only one month old and still can’t hold his neck up properly, just getting him to sit and face forward was already a mission haha. Thankfully, we found an app that lets you take passport photos at home that meet the official requirements! (Not an ad)

In the end, we failed several times, changed positions, tried taking the photo while he was lying down, then sitting again… After many attempts, we finally managed to get one usable photo! When we received the printed photos later, we couldn’t help but think, “Is this really a passport photo?” but at the same time we felt strangely proud. Just like that, Piyo got his very first passport at only 40 days old 😊

These days our daily life is completely in “newborn parenting mode.” At night he suddenly cries, cries while eating, cries while sleeping… Sometimes we panic because we can’t figure out why he’s crying, but every day still feels so new and precious. Maybe someday when Piyo watches this video, he’ll laugh and say, “So this is how my first passport photo was made.” haha

Anyway, we hope you enjoy today’s video!

en.title: (ENG) FIRST TIME MEETING THE NEWBORN BABY OF THE FAMILY😭 *emotional*
en.description:
Four days after leaving the postpartum care center, Kyung-sik's parents and grandmother came up from Daejeon to meet Piyo! 
The adults were so eager to see Piyo that they got their pertussis shots ahead of time and waited patiently. It's such a relief we could meet like this, all healthy and well❤️
I agonized over whether to cut Grandpa's part from the video because it felt too personal, like family history. But I wanted Piyo to remember Grandpa when he watches this video someday far in the future, and I also hoped the remaining family members would watch it often and not forget their feelings for Grandpa, so I included it in the video. 
It was truly regrettable that he passed away without seeing his great-grandson, but thinking about it now, I feel fortunate we could at least personally tell him the pregnancy news :)
So please enjoy today's video too~

snippet.title: 영상통화하다가 멈춘 척 반응보기ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
snippet.description:
세상에!!! 여러분!!!!!!!!!!!
저번에 언파 치약 영상 올린 뒤로 반응이 좋아서 언파측에서 쿠키커플 팔로워분들께 최저가 공구와 구매 인증 이벤트를 준비해주셨어요😍
신세계 상품권 10만원권의 주인공이 누가 될지!!!!!!!!

일정은
 📆 2/9 ~ 2/15까지!

준비한 제품은👇
1. 언파 차차 에너지 잇몸 치약 외 5종 모음전 + 차차칫솔 증정
정상가 48,200원 → 공구가 19,800원

2. 언파 차차 치약 대용량 250g 4개 + 차차칫솔 증정
정상가 108,600원 → 공구가 39,600원

다양한 품목이랑 대용량까지 전부 최저가로 준비해주셨니 직접 사용하셔도 되고 선물용으로도 편하게 선택해보세요 🙂


그리고 댓글 구매 인증 이벤트도 있어요!
구매 후 인스타 피드 댓글에 인증해주시면 (지마켓 주문번호 기입 필수) 추첨으로 드립니다 🎁 
❌️숏폼 영상에 댓글쓰는거 아니에요!!!❌️

•    구매왕(1명) : 신세계 상품권 10만원권
•    구매 인증(10명) : 스타벅스 상품권 1만원권 또는 신세계 상품권 1만원권

구매 링크는 쿠키커플 인스타 프로필 링크에서 확인하시면 됩니다 🙂
